text:
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt for release v2.7.3 -> canary failed: staging-smoke integration step failed (artifact fetch DNS error) — blocking promotion.

mariam: saw this too. which stage failed exactly?

deploy-bot: step=staging-smoke, job=integration-gateway, error=artifact-registry.internal lookup NXDOMAIN (attempts=3)

aj: pinged the registry from staging runner, got intermittent NXDOMAIN for artifact-registry.internal. could be caching/record TTL on the edge.

sam: hmm, artifact was pushed an hour ago. I can try re-pushing the artifact (sha: sha256:abcd1234) if needed.

devops: before re-push, can you run a curl from the same runner namespace to confirm? I suspect a local CoreDNS cache flapped.

leo: quick check from runner: ```$ nslookup artifact-registry.internal 10.128.0.10 Server: 10.128.0.10 Address: 10.128.0.10#53 
** server can't find artifact-registry.internal: NXDOMAIN```

mariam: thanks. any sign of S3/registry 403 or object missing? logs show DNS-only, no 403.

aj: deploy-bot has auto-retry in 5m but this is risky during change window. options: 1) wait and let retry run, 2) pin to last-good image and promote, 3) manual rerun after DNS fix, 4) re-push artifact now.

sam: I'm leaning to pin to last-good image to keep the rollout moving for customers; revertable later. Patch is minor anyway.

devops: pin is safe if the last-good is compatible with canary checks. we should also record it in release notes and signal that v2.7.3 is held for a re-run.

mariam: agree. deploy-bot, can you pin to image sha256:efgh5678 (last-good) and mark the promotion as manual-pin?

deploy-bot: Accepted. Pinning to sha256:efgh5678 and promoting to canary now. Promotion status: starting canary rollout -> progress 0% -> smoke checks running.

leo: filing a short incident note: "staging DNS cache experienced NXDOMAIN for artifact-registry.internal causing integration fetch failures; promotion pinned to last-good artifact; follow-up: CoreDNS TTL and upstream resolver health check."

aj: i'll re-run the artifact push in parallel and keep a note. if the re-push completes and DNS stabilizes, we can unpin and promote the intended v2.7.3.

mariam: for release notes: delay the v2.7.3 public announcement until we've verified the intended artifact can be fetched. add line: "Deployment pinned to prior artifact due to transient staging DNS outage; final release pending verification."

sam: change window tonight at 22:00 UTC still available for final promote.

devops: investigating CoreDNS pod restarts and caching layer; will update in #eng-infra if we need a manual TTL flush. :mag: 

deploy-bot: Can confirm canary smoke checks passed on pinned artifact. Promotion to canary complete at 1719992045. Manual follow-up scheduled: unpin check at 1719995600 (approx 1h)

mariam: thanks everyone. action items: devops follow up on DNS, sam to re-push artifact, aj to watch the unpin window, i'll update release notes and notify PM. :thumbsup:
